narrative: On the tables. The erasable leaf on the board at the lodging. Three short lines, and a box of two houses with a street between them. No speech is on the leaf. Brooke is still on the shelf.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote three lines on the tables and did not open the poem.

entities.name: tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in Two houses, and no words
